code_summary: The ensemble retains the LightGCN graph expert, SASRec sampled-softmax training, and validation-selected reciprocal-rank fusion. Each SASRec attention block adds a zero-initialized learned relative-distance bias of shape [num_heads, maxlen], expanded into a causal additive attention mask while preserving absolute positional embeddings and existing padding behavior. Versioned checkpoints and the generated predictor reconstruct the new architecture across all four dataset routes. Added checks cover zero-bias equivalence, bias gradients, causality, candidate ordering, and predictor reload agreement; their execution results are unavailable.
